# Camp Resource: Nuka Cola Candy Machine

Nuka-Cola Candy right at your finger tips!

- Collects Candy over time -

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Nuka Cola Candy Machine__

**Produces**

Nuka-Cola Candy

Nuka-Cola Candy counts as Candy and Pre-war food for Collect and Consume Score Challenges.

Consuming a candy gives you a random chance to receive one of four different buffs, lasting for 10 minutes.

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

24 Nuka-Cola Candy

**Obtainable via**

Season 11 - Nuka World - Rank 5 - Free

Atom Shop - Fallout First __Nuka-World Catch Up Bundle__ - 1500 Atoms

**Produces X amount per**

10 minutes and 12 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

2 Flamingo Units
